profile_text.body:
ELLIS, also known as the European Laboratory for Learning and Intelligent Systems, is a pan-European nonprofit AI research network headquartered in Europe. According to its site, it unites top AI researchers through Programs, Sites, and a PhD program, with the stated aim of securing lasting international leadership of AI made in Europe by connecting researchers and creating a multi-centric AI research laboratory. It describes itself as fostering international collaboration across domains and investing in the next generation of AI talent.

The network is organized around three main structures. Sites serve as hubs for AI research across Europe and can be made up of local AI research institutions and universities or newly created Institutes. Programs focus on theoretical foundations, algorithms, and applications such as health and climate, and are led by ELLIS Fellows and Scholars. The ELLIS PhD and Postdoc Program pairs students with leading researchers across Europe in machine learning, AI and related fields, offering international exchanges and joint supervision. The site also notes that the University of Stuttgart has been a member of the network since 2021, that the ELLIS Doctoral Symposium 2026 was organized by ELLIS Unit Lisbon and drew more than 100 PhD students, postdocs, researchers, and AI experts, and that a postdoc position in AI/ML methods for target identification for neuropsychiatric diseases is offered at Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC).

The record holds no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for ELLIS.
